mentions.name: Past Visiting Hours
mentions.description: A multiplayer horror game built with Godot and Blender, using Qwen3 TTS and AI-assisted tooling (Deepseek Flash with Pi) to rapidly prototype and iterate on gameplay. The game is available to wishlist on Steam, with a planned release price of around $5.
mentions.problem: Work and family commitments left the builder without the time needed to make a game they could be proud of and publish; AI-assisted development compressed execution from years to months.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So yeah... this is what I have been working for several months now.
If you're interested it's available to wishlist on Steam today.
iirc I think it'll be somewhere in the ballpark of $5 on release

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1440860/Past_Visiting_Hours/
